notes.title: Red Blaster Demo Updated to 1.1
notes.content:
Last major update regarding the Demo for Red Blaster, in which the changes will be included in the launch build of the game. Major changes include: a total overhaul of the in-game rolling background, added two new powerups, an overhaul of the upgrades shop menu and further levels and enemy balancing.

Changelog:
- upgraded the rolling in-game background from a simple checkered image to different procedurally generated "boards" I call them;
- added 2 powerups that have a chance to spawn when destroying certain enemies: a lightning powerup that increases fire-rate and a shield powerup which makes the player invulnerable to enemies and their projectiles; each powerup lasts for 5 seconds and can be active simultaneously
- overhauled the shop menu to better streamline upgrades and values when changed and upgraded, better values' cost visibility and added a weapon stats info box
- changed the blaster firing sounds
- further tweaked waves, levels and enemy balancing and difficulty
- tweaked the appearances of in-game menus and panels
- added the option to change resolutions and a full-screen toggle
- increased total playable levels to 25

notes.title: Red Blaster Demo update to 1.0.1
notes.content:
The demo for Red Blaster has been updated to 1.0.1 with the following changes:
- rebalanced all the levels (made upgrades more expensive, lowered enemy spawn rates, tough enemies spawn later levels); should make early gameplay easier
- introduced a health restoring power-up: a wrench will have a chance to spawn when destroying an enemy if the player is not at full health
- renamed "Lives" to "Health"
- changed buttons' color scheme to a more eye-pleasing light-blue
- redesigned some of the in-game backgrounds
- added mouse sensitivity slider in the in-game options menu from the pause screen
- added numerical values representing the upgrades in the shop and for the volume sliders and mouse sensitivity
- added a gradient color palette to each menu panel as to not look too bland
- introduced an option for resetting game progress in the options menu (which I highly recommend players who completed the demo to try in order to experience the new balancing of enemies)
